text.5:22: They said: O Moses! Lo! a giant people (dwell) therein and lo! we go not in till they go forth from thence. When they go forth from thence, then we will enter (not till then).
text.11:59: And such were A'ad. They denied the revelations of their Lord and flouted His messengers and followed the command of every froward potentate.
text.14:15: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;
text.19:14: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.
text.19:32: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.
text.26:130: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?
text.28:19: And when he would have fallen upon the man who was an enemy unto them both, he said: O Moses! Wouldst thou kill me as thou didst kill a person yesterday. Thou wouldst be nothing but a tyrant in the land, thou wouldst not be of the reformers.
text.40:35: Those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without any warrant that hath come unto them, it is greatly hateful in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who believe. Thus doth Allah print on every arrogant, disdainful heart.
text.50:45: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
text.59:23: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).
